metadata.question: Did over half of the total land area in the Isles Dernières Barrier Islands Refuge become permanently lost to erosion and sea level rise from 2000 to 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Need to analyze land area change in Isles Dernières Barrier Islands Refuge from 2000 to 2024 - Will use Landsat collections (Landsat 5/7 for 2000, Landsat 8/9 for 2024) - Need to identify water vs land using spectral indices (NDWI or MNDWI) - Location: Isles Dernières Barrier Islands Refuge, Louisiana coast 2. Masking strategy: - Mask clouds to get clear view of land/water boundary - Use water indices to classify land vs water - MNDWI > 0 typically indicates water 3. Logic: - Calculate land area in 2000 and 2024 - Compare: if (2000_land - 2024_land) / 2000_land > 0.5, then answer A (Yes) - Valid zero land area would be unusual but possible (C2) - No data scenarios handled with C1 - Calculation errors with C3 ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define the study area - Isles Dernières Barrier Islands Refuge, Louisiana const refuge = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-90.95, 29.0], [-90.95, 29.15], [-90.65, 29.15], [-90.65, 29.0], [-90.95, 29.0]] ]); // Function to mask clouds for Landsat 5/7 function maskL57Clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } // Function to mask clouds for Landsat 8/9 function maskL89Clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const cloudMask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(cloudMask); } // Function to calculate MNDWI and classify land function addLandMask(image) { const green = image.select('SR_B2'); const swir = image.select('SR_B5'); const mndwi = green.subtract(swir).divide(green.add(swir)).rename('MNDWI'); const land = mndwi.lt(0).rename('land'); return image.addBands([mndwi, land]); } function addLandMaskL89(image) { const green = image.select('SR_B3'); const swir = image.select('SR_B6'); const mndwi = green.subtract(swir).divide(green.add(swir)).rename('MNDWI'); const land = mndwi.lt(0).rename('land'); return image.addBands([mndwi, land]); } // Get 2000 data (Landsat 7) let col2000 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(refuge) .filterDate('2000-01-01', '2000-12-31') .map(maskL57Clouds) .map(addLandMask); const size2000 = col2000.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2000 Images found: ${size2000}`); if (size2000 === 0) { console.log('No images for 2000'); console.log('C1'); return; } // Get 2024 data (Landsat 9) let col2024 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(refuge) .filterDate('2024-01-01', '2024-12-31') .map(maskL89Clouds) .map(addLandMaskL89); const size2024 = col2024.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2024 Images found: ${size2024}`); if (size2024 === 0) { console.log('No images for 2024, trying Landsat 8'); col2024 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(refuge) .filterDate('2024-01-01', '2024-12-31') .map(maskL89Clouds) .map(addLandMaskL89); const size2024_l8 = col2024.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2024 Landsat 8 Images found: ${size2024_l8}`); if (size2024_l8 === 0) { console.log('No images for 2024'); console.log('C1'); return; } } // Create median composites const img2000 = col2000.median(); const img2024 = col2024.median(); // Calculate land area for 2000 const land2000Stats = img2000.select('land').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: refuge, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const landPixels2000 = land2000Stats.get('land_sum').getInfo(); const totalPixels2000 = land2000Stats.get('land_count').getInfo(); console.log(`2000: Land pixels = ${landPixels2000}, Total valid pixels = ${totalPixels2000}`); if (totalPixels2000 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2000 after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // Calculate land area for 2024 const land2024Stats = img2024.select('land').reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: refuge, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const landPixels2024 = land2024Stats.get('land_sum').getInfo(); const totalPixels2024 = land2024Stats.get('land_count').getInfo(); console.log(`2024: Land pixels = ${landPixels2024}, Total valid pixels = ${totalPixels2024}`); if (totalPixels2024 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2024 after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } if (landPixels2000 === null || landPixels2024 === null) { console.log('Calculation failed - null result'); console.log('C3'); return; } // Calculate land area in km² const landArea2000 = (landPixels2000 * 30 * 30) / 1e6; const landArea2024 = (landPixels2024 * 30 * 30) / 1e6; const areaLost = landArea2000 - landArea2024; const percentLost = (areaLost / landArea2000) * 100; console.log(`2000 Land Area: ${landArea2000.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`2024 Land Area: ${landArea2024.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Area Lost: ${areaLost.toFixed(2)} km² (${percentLost.toFixed(1)}%)`); if (percentLost > 50) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
